title: Independent reproduction and external attestation intake

intake_stages.name: public_submission
intake_stages.test: A public receipt and evidence bundle is submitted through the registered intake surface.

intake_stages.name: structural_validation
intake_stages.test: The receipt passes the machine schema and exact-reference checks.

intake_stages.name: independence_and_conflict_review
intake_stages.test: A human reviewer verifies identity, relationships, funding, contribution history, and conflicts.

intake_stages.name: evidence_and_reproduction_review
intake_stages.test: A human reviewer inspects custody, commands, outputs, deviations, signatures, and exact-byte results.

intake_stages.name: registry_adjudication
intake_stages.test: A dated external adjudication receipt enters the append-preserving registry without an open blocker.

clean_room_requirements: fresh checkout of the exact commit in a workspace not supplied by the project, vendor, operator, or assessed adopter
no reuse of build outputs, dependency directories, caches containing project outputs, private fixtures, unpublished patches, or maintainer-provided artifacts
publicly obtainable source and dependency material only
complete environment, command, output, deviation, custody, and signature records
public evidence bundle retained beyond the receipt expiry
automatic_disqualifiers: receipt generated by a project bot or project-controlled CI
reproducer is a repository administrator or maintainer
reproducer contributed to the frozen reference capsule
reproducer is the vendor, operator, customer, or assessed adopter
reproducer is the same legal entity as a disqualified party
identity, funding, relationship, or conflict disclosure is missing
workspace or artifacts were supplied by a disqualified party
reference commit or exact-byte bundle hash differs
required command fails, is omitted, or is replaced
evidence is private, missing, mutable without versioning, or expires before the receipt
human_review_flags: current or recent employment, contract, funding, investment, governance, family, or close professional relationship
compensation contingent on a successful reproduction or adoption claim
evidence hosting controlled by the project, vendor, operator, or adopter
selective logs, missing denominators, unexplained retries, or inaccessible raw outputs
signature authority or signatory identity not independently verifiable

revocation_triggers: new evidence of project control or artifact reuse
custody_and_revocation.revocation_effect: A1 support is removed prospectively; historical receipt and reasons remain visible; project ceiling returns to the highest independently supported level.

registry.title: Independent reproduction receipt registry

reconciliation.reason: No non-operator receipt has been submitted, structurally validated, independently adjudicated, and entered without an open blocker.
reconciliation.next_action: Accept public receipts through the registered intake surface; do not solicit or authorize real-person deployment.

mutation_rules: the structural CLI may not write this registry
approval requires separate independence and evidence adjudication receipts
maintainers may record an adjudication but may not serve as the independent reproducer or sole independence adjudicator
expiry, revocation, or evidence loss removes current A1 support without deleting history
